articles.summary: LITTLE ELM, Texas – Retractable Technologies, Inc. (NYSE American: RVP) reports that it has reduced its workforce by approximately 16%. The reduction is expected to save an estimated $2.2 million in annual wages and employment benefits, or approximately 13% of total estimated workforce costs.
